title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Trócaire’s Global Hub on Partnership and Localisation, the programme contributes to outcome 6.1 Trócaire fulfils its commitment to localisation while inspiring sectoral transformation in solidarity with local actors. The objective is to increase the voice and influence of local and national partners in key spaces nationally and internationally. Activities include provision of technical support to partners, particularly WCOs, to maximise participation in decision-making spaces; promoting the visibility of partners in external communications; and provision of technical support to Trócaire’s country offices on promoting partner voice and influence. The programme is in partnership with Arid Lands Development Focus and Community Empowerment for Rural Development. Note: partners may change in future years . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 6.1Trócaire fulfils its commitment to localisation while inspiring sectoral transformation in solidarity with local actors. . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:Partnership and localisation; with a focus on Women Centred OrganisationsCapacity building of Trócaire staff on partnership and localisation
